definitions.explanation: Holding back or being reserved in expressing one's true thoughts or opinions out of respect, fear, or social consideration. Almost always appears in the negative form {忌憚|きたん}なく (without reserve).

examples.japanese: {忌憚|きたん}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦ない→ない：01118_nai⟧⟦{意見|いけん}→意見：01303_iken⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦ください→下さい：02899_kudasai⟧。
examples.english: Please give me your frank opinion.

examples.japanese: {忌憚|きたん}⟦なく→ない：01118_nai⟧⟦{申|もう}し{上|あ}げます→申し上げる：01734_moushiageru⟧。
⟦どう→どう：00543_dou⟧⟦か→か：09473_ka⟧{忌憚|きたん}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦ない→ない：01118_nai⟧ご⟦{意見|いけん}→意見：01303_iken⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧お⟦{聞|き}かせ→聞く：00483_kiku⟧⟦ください→下さい：02899_kudasai⟧。
examples.english: Please share your candid opinion with us.

examples.japanese: {忌憚|きたん}⟦なく→ない：01118_nai⟧⟦{議論|ぎろん}できる→議論する：06058_gironsuru⟧⟦{場|ば}→場：03699_ba⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{必要|ひつよう}→必要：00846_hitsuyou⟧だ。
examples.english: We need a place where we can discuss things openly.

notes:
{忌憚|きたん} is almost exclusively used in the negative form to mean "without reserve" or "frankly."

Key expressions:
- {忌憚|きたん}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦ない→ない：01118_nai⟧ + noun (frank, candid, unreserved)
- {忌憚|きたん}⟦なく→ない：01118_nai⟧ + verb (without hesitation, frankly)

Common collocations:
- {忌憚|きたん}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦ない→ない：01118_nai⟧⟦{意見|いけん}→意見：01303_iken⟧ (frank opinion)
- {忌憚|きたん}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦ない→ない：01118_nai⟧⟦{批判|ひはん}→批判：03580_hihan⟧ (candid criticism)
- {忌憚|きたん}⟦なく→ない：01118_nai⟧⟦{言|い}う→言う：00515_iu⟧ (to say frankly)

Note: This is a formal expression commonly used in business and official contexts when inviting honest feedback or indicating one will speak candidly.

Related words:
- ⟦{遠慮|えんりょ}→遠慮：01337_enryo⟧⟦なく→ない：01118_nai⟧: without hesitation (more common)
- ⟦{率直|そっちょく}→率直：13491_socchoku⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧: frankly, candidly
- ⟦{本音|ほんね}→本音：06620_honne⟧: true feelings, real intention
